name: codex-optimizer
description: Silently rewrite supported shell commands with RTK, analyze output-compaction candidates without duplicate model context, and keep responses concise.

interface.shortDescription: Silent RTK rewrites and token-neutral output analysis.
interface.longDescription: A hook-backed Codex optimizer for coding tasks. It silently rewrites supported Bash commands through RTK, records output-compaction candidate metrics without emitting hook output or duplicate model context, and enables concise Caveman responses.
interface.defaultPrompt: Automatically apply Caveman full, silent RTK command rewriting, and token-neutral output-stage analysis to this coding task.
